title: Shirley Telfer — Family & Biography
body_markdown:
# Shirley Edna Telfer (née Parker)

**Role:** Wife of Murray John Telfer, mother of the modern Telfer generation

Shirley Edna Parker married Murray John Telfer, son of Reginald Masters Telfer and Elma Ellen Pubsley. The book records them with three sons — Darryl William, John Robert, and Grantley Keith — on the family tree of John Telfer (1847–1929) and Caroline Amelia Masters.

Their family continued with Timothy Neil, Kathryn Mavis, and Susan Shirley.

The book also records another Shirley in the family — Shirley May Telfer (daughter of Claude Rex Telfer, great-granddaughter of Adam Francis Telfer), who married Howard Arnold Pape — but that is a different branch (Adam Francis line, not John Telfer line).

**Source:** *From the Borders to the Bush* — pages 175, 347
